title: Webflow Website Design and Development | The Brandle
description: Custom Webflow website design from a Dubai studio. Built from a blank canvas with a CMS your team can edit. Fixed quote first, live in 3 to 6 weeks.

hub.name: Webflow design
hub.line: Custom sites your team can edit without us.

hero.joke: For people who want a custom site and never want to email a developer about a typo.
hero.intro: Webflow website design and development: custom layouts, a CMS your team can run, and motion that knows when to stop. Built from a blank canvas, with no template underneath. Fixed quote, 3 to 6 weeks.

items.p: No template under the bonnet. Layouts drawn for your content, then built to match the design to the pixel.
Blog, case studies, team, jobs. Structured so adding one means filling in a form, not rebuilding a page.
Scroll and hover effects that guide the eye. If an animation doesn't help someone read, it goes.
Checked at desktop, tablet and phone widths. Not just squeezed until it fits.
Clean markup, compressed images, a title and description on every page, and a sitemap that updates itself.
A walkthrough of the Editor, and the site moved to your own Webflow account. You hold the keys.

fit.p: Webflow suits marketing sites that change often and have to look sharp. It comes with a monthly hosting fee, and it isn't a shop platform. For what it's good at, it's very good.
yes: Publishing posts or case studies every month
Keen to edit pages without calling a developer
After custom design, not a theme with your logo on it
Leaving WordPress and its weekly plugin updates
fit.no: you need a big online store, which is [Shopify](/services/shopify-website-design/) territory, or a launch page in a hurry, where [Framer](/services/framer-website-design/) is quicker. [WordPress](/services/wordpress-website-design/) still wins if you want to own the hosting.

proof.label: Our own work
proof.p: Tideline is our own Webflow template: a seafront tower, floor plans, a materials page and a map. It's a product we made, not a client job, and it shows how we build in Webflow when nobody is telling us what to do.

items.p: A free call, a sitemap and a fixed quote. We agree what's in before anyone opens Webflow.
Key pages in Figma first, with real copy where you have it.
Built in Webflow with a tidy class system, CMS collections and interactions. You watch it grow on a staging link.
Redirects, launch, an Editor walkthrough, and the project transferred to your account. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Our fixed plans run from $1,299 to $6,499, about AED 4,800 to 23,900. Page count and CMS depth decide where you land. Webflow's hosting plan is separate and paid to Webflow. A site takes 3 to 6 weeks.

tools.note: Built in Webflow, designed in Figma. The other three are platforms we move people off. No partner badges, just the work.

faq.q: Can I edit the site after launch?
faq.a: Yes, and it's a big reason to choose Webflow. Text, images and CMS items are edited in the browser. The layout itself stays locked unless you'd like the keys to that too.

faq.q: Can you move my current site to Webflow?
faq.a: We rebuild it in Webflow and bring the content across from WordPress, Wix, Squarespace or wherever it lives, with a redirect for every old address. [How to redesign a website without losing SEO](/blog/website-redesign-without-losing-seo/) explains the method.

Webflow if you want less maintenance and tighter design control. WordPress if you need a particular plugin or want to choose your own host. The longer answer is in [WordPress vs Webflow](/blog/wordpress-vs-webflow/).
You do, directly to Webflow, on your own account. That way the site never depends on us paying a bill.

cta.p: Tell us what the site has to do. We reply within one business day with questions, then a number.
